---

MTB registration success uses `mtb_reg`; discussion success uses numeric
`n_mtb >= 1`. The discussion-count distribution and missingness are retained.
No referral proxy or follow-up month classification is substituted.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

source(here::here("analysis", "_module-common.R"), local = FALSE)
liqplat_source_public_helpers()
config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- module_force()
stage_id <- "implementation_mtb"
result_dir <- module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "04-implementation"))
checkpoint_path <- module_checkpoint_path(stage_id)
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "mtb-summary.parquet")
distribution_path <- file.path(result_dir, "mtb-discussion-distribution.parquet")
figure_path <- file.path(result_dir, "mtb-discussion-distribution.svg")
cohort_path <- file.path(module_result_dir(file.path("analysis", "00-data")),
                         "analysis-cohort.parquet")
if (!file.exists(cohort_path)) stop("MTB analysis requires the built analysis cohort.")
input_paths <- c(cohort_path, private_domain_path(config, "cohort_follow_up"),
                 schema_domain_path(config, "cohort_follow_up"))
input_paths <- input_paths[file.exists(input_paths)]
output_paths <- c(summary_path, distribution_path, figure_path)
decision <- checkpoint_decision(
  checkpoint_path, stage_id, input_paths = input_paths,
  output_paths = output_paths,
  code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "08-mtb.qmd"),
  config = config, force = force
)

if (identical(decision, "skip")) {
  mtb_summary <- read_result_table(summary_path)
} else {
  cohort <- read_result_table(cohort_path)
  require_public_columns(cohort, c("id", "mtb_reg", "n_mtb"), "MTB outcomes")
  cohort_ids <- unique(cohort$id[!is.na(cohort$id)])
  referral <- validate_binary(cohort$mtb_reg, "mtb_reg")
  discussion_count <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(cohort$n_mtb)))
  invalid_count <- !is.na(discussion_count) &
    (!is.finite(discussion_count) | discussion_count < 0 |
       discussion_count != floor(discussion_count))
  if (any(invalid_count)) {
    stop("MTB discussion counts must be non-negative integers.")
  }
  registered_ids <- unique(cohort$id[referral == 1 & !is.na(cohort$id)])
  discussed_ids <- unique(cohort$id[!is.na(discussion_count) &
                                       discussion_count >= 1 & !is.na(cohort$id)])
  mtb_summary <- data.frame(
    patients = length(cohort_ids),
    mtb_registered = length(registered_ids),
    mtb_registered_proportion = if (length(cohort_ids) == 0L) NA_real_ else
      length(registered_ids) / length(cohort_ids),
    mtb_discussed = length(discussed_ids),
    mtb_discussed_proportion = if (length(cohort_ids) == 0L) NA_real_ else
      length(discussed_ids) / length(cohort_ids),
    missing_discussion_count = sum(is.na(discussion_count)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  distribution <- as.data.frame(table(discussion_count, useNA = "ifany"),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(distribution) <- c("n_mtb", "patients")
  distribution$n_mtb <- as.character(distribution$n_mtb)
  write_module_table(mtb_summary, summary_path)
  write_module_table(distribution, distribution_path)
  if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required for the MTB figure.")
  }
  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    distribution[distribution$n_mtb != "NA", , drop = FALSE],
    ggplot2::aes(x = n_mtb, y = patients)
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Recorded MTB discussion count", y = "Patients") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
  assert_artifact_path(figure_path)
  ggplot2::ggsave(figure_path, plot = plot, width = 7, height = 4, units = "in")
  finalize_module_checkpoint(
    stage_id = stage_id,
    checkpoint_path = checkpoint_path,
    input_paths = input_paths,
    output_paths = output_paths,
    config = config,
    metadata = list(data_lock = config_get(config, "analysis", "data_lock"),
                    status = "built", definition = "mtb_reg_and_n_mtb_at_least_one"),
    code_paths = here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "08-mtb.qmd")
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: mtb-summary
#| tbl-cap: "MTB registration and discussion summary"

mtb_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
